title: Sybil Brand Commission for Institutional Inspections (SBC) January 8, 2026 Meeting
description:
The Sybil Brand Commission for Institutional Inspections (SBC) meeting of January 8, 2026, reviewed key operational conditions within Los Angeles County correctional facilities. Updates focused on improvements to food services, sanitation and water safety, digital access expansion, and custodial staffing stability. The Commission also received a detailed report on in custody deaths for 2025, noting 46 total deaths and ongoing tracking into 2026.

A significant portion of the meeting centered on serious Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) related sexual misconduct allegations at CRDF, including reports of cross-gender viewing of showers, harassment, and forced acts. Commissioners emphasized the urgency of transparency and corrective action. Requests were made for detailed reports, including Century Regional Detention Facility (CRDF) inspection findings and participation from both Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department (LASD’s) PREA Coordinator and District Attorney Nathan Hochman.

Overall, the Commission prioritized accountability, facility safety, and immediate follow up on allegations of staff misconduct.
